status: Synthetic design fixtures only; no application test execution

usage.note: Numbers are synthetic; unknown actual vendor commercial terms must be verified.

tests.expected: Use synthetic shared inbox A and personal inbox B. Preview filing exposure before consent. Activate filing for A but leave reply disabled; a new inquiry may file but produces no reply. Disconnect A and prove no future read/send action while retained records remain subject to matter permissions.

Submit fixtures DIRECT-1, REFERRAL-1, UNCERTAIN-1 and PORTAL-1. Only policy-qualified direct inquiry enters automated conversation. Others remain visible for human review with reason and raw message. Replaying each delivery creates no duplicate lead or outgoing reply.

Run the same synthetic inquiry before connection and after a draft configuration change. Show version, generated response and fit explanation; make zero provider sends or billable production lead events. Publishing the configuration is a distinct operation with an audit entry.

Evaluate Gmail, Microsoft365-hosted Business, third-party Exchange and revoked-consent fixtures. Explain unsupported host or missing tenant approval. Connect two addresses for one user and one shared address for two users; preserve ownership and one provider-message identity across modules.

Connect at November15,2026 14:00 UTC with messages before and after that instant. Record actual configured backfill boundary. Change Contacts to Everyone and back; show exact affected IDs before committing, no source-mail deletion and recoverable audit history for removed application copies. Do not infer unlimited historical backfill.

A contact has matters M-A and M-B. Match exact subject naming M-A, leave ambiguous mail unresolved, then select M-B manually. New replies inherit that assignment with provenance. A later explicit conflicting matter name triggers review and does not silently move previously filed evidence.

Rename fixture thread locally, export its original and verify original subject. Refile, choose no matter, then remove its application copy in a disposable environment. Provider messages remain unchanged. Disconnect stops future ingestion; records are not erased merely because authorization ended.

Validate synthetic hosted, custom and WordPress fixtures without modifying a live site. Detect duplicate embed, wrong configured domain, unsupported builder and competing chatbot. Preview succeeds without publication; publish only with valid configuration. Record cache and stacking-order issues separately from missing lead ingestion.

Start a synthetic chat without contact details, then create one lead. Emit one start event and one lead event per configured semantics, preserving attribution. Repeat with analytics blocked: lead still persists. Never place the analytics secret in exported logs or browser-visible public configuration.

Accept synthetic appointment lead against existing C-1/M-1; retain appointment identity and raw inquiry with no duplicate. Accept an unscheduled lead through quick intake. Fit qualification does not mark conflicts cleared. Concurrent acceptance retries yield a single transition and attributable operator.

For identical scheduled leads compare Ignore with Ignore-and-cancel. Only cancellation variant changes appointment and queues a cancellation notification. Record effect IDs and failures; retry sends once. Already-added must link truthful existing records and preserve the original event rather than serving as an arbitrary billing bypass.

Move synthetic lead to spam then restore to review with prior history intact. Test permanent purge only on disposable fixtures: exact selection/count, retained lawful audit metadata and unavailable normal restoration must be explicit. A partial purge failure cannot report total success. No purge performed during audit.

Load chat, phone and email fixtures. Keep original conversation, transcript or filed message links distinct from summaries. Override fit from poor to good with actor/reason/time; retain original assessment and configuration. Missing source evidence is flagged rather than replaced by generated text.

Import third-party lead with no engagement and mark hired: no assisted charge. Engage a second lead and hire its matter: exactly one configured charge. Repeat status webhook and merge duplicate lead; no duplicate charge. Price and currency are configurable, not copied from an older comparison.

Set target two, place three assisted matters in pipeline and hire two. New assistance pauses after allowed in-flight completion. Hire the third: show its configured charge and explain outstanding exposure. Next cycle resumes according to policy. A separately offered hard cap requires its own enforceable semantics and test.

Use synthetic November15–December14,2026 cycle, configurable currency/threshold and five charge events. Midcycle invoice reduces unbilled balance, not event totals. Deactivate, cancel or change cycle; invoice accrued events once. Retry invoice webhooks, credits and failures without lost or duplicate balances.

Configure synthetic offer with N free hires and explicit terms version, not a presumed current vendor allowance. Consume N then another hire; show ledger allocation. Compare actual target pause with forecast alert and month rollover. Activity history remains traceable through failed actions, duplicates and deactivation.
